name: Dark Reign: An Avengers Reading List
description: Norman Osborn runs his own Avengers, while the real team and the Initiative go underground. Dark Avengers, Mighty Avengers, Avengers: The Initiative and New Avengers are read in turn. Dark Avengers #7 and 8 are picked up later with the Utopia crossover. Dark Reign: Young Avengers and the Children's Crusade close the journey.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
